context.title: League of Women Voters — selected ongoing federal policy stances

of.name: League of Women Voters of the United States

subject.title: Federal voting-rights legislation expanding access (Freedom to Vote Act-type)

positions.statement: Researcher summary of LWV's long-standing public stance favoring federal legislation that protects and expands voter access — including automatic and same-day registration, no-excuse absentee voting, and strong nationwide voting standards.
Researcher summary of LWV's long-standing opposition to partisan gerrymandering and support for placing redistricting authority in independent, transparent commissions.

subject.title: Statehood for the District of Columbia

positions.statement: Researcher summary of LWV's publicly stated support for full voting representation for DC residents, including DC statehood.
